title: ChineseSafe: A Chinese Benchmark for Evaluating Safety in Large Language Models

bias_targets.target: Social bias and Discrimination (e.g., Racial, Gender, Appearance)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the models' ability to correctly identify unethical and discriminatory content (such as racial discrimination or appearance-based prejudice) by formulating prompts as yes/no questions and assessing the outputs using both generation-based and perplexity-based methods.
